text:
QUOTE: "If neither holds and an `on_tool_call` callback is registered, the call is approved anyway... With no callback and no match, the call is denied with 'Permission denied'."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer frames the posture as default-deny ("a call runs only if it clears a fixed sequence of checks"). It says an unmatched call is approved only when a callback is registered, and denied otherwise. It never concludes that a tool matching neither list simply runs.
